history: What is the Journeyman Plumbing Exam?
what_is_it: The Journeyman plumbing license is one of the most critical milestones in a plumber's career. It signifies that an apprentice has completed their required hours and has the expertise to work independently.
requirements: The concept of a 'Journeyman' dates back to the medieval trade guilds where a worker had completed their apprenticeship but was not yet a master. In modern plumbing

column17: and local code compliance. It usually consists of 100-125 multiple-choice questions.
column18: Most states require 4 to 5 years (roughly 8000 hours) of documented apprenticeship under a Master Plumber before you can sit for the exam.
